title: finally talking to my gf's family
body: my girlfriend is from mexico and most of her family speaks spanish. i've been learning for a while but i'm def not at the “sit at dinner and understand 5 people talking at full speed” level yet lol. usually she ends up translating for me which i know gets annoying for both of us. i tried this app during a family get together and the listening/headphone feature is honestly what made me write this review. i had one earbud in and being able to hear translations made it so much easier to follow what everyone was talking about without constantly asking my girlfriend “wait what did they say?” 😂 i still try to understand as much spanish as i can first, but having this as a backup makes me way more comfortable joining conversations. i've also been using it when texting her mom bc i can check what i'm about to send before embarrassing myself lol. obviously it's not gonna magically make me fluent but it makes the language barrier feel a lot smaller. and i'm actually picking up more spanish from hearing/seeing the same phrases over and over. really really useful app.
